name: CineTrace Video Forensics
author: Arif Mughal
tagline: Evidence-first forensic reconstruction of how social videos were made.
description: Analyze authorized YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, and local videos to extract provenance metadata, C2PA clues, encoder fingerprints, audio measurements, shot timelines, edit structure, captions, compositing, likely toolchains, platform metadata, and reproducible forensic reports.
indexing_phrases: find how a social media video was edited
identify likely video production tools from evidence
claims_policy: Never claim exact software, AI model, private prompt, or creation time without direct evidence.
